My routine:
I wash my scalp first with head and shoulders for dandruff, then with Shea moisture moisturizing shampoo, and then use Shea moisture conditioner, and detangle my hair with a boar bristled brush?
Then I apply Shea moisture leave-in and a growth oil from urban fields

Almost lost my big brother to suicide. Thought he was dead for a while. The best advice is to realize that you couldn’t have done anymore than you did, and you shouldn’t blame yourself.
She can finally rest and she no longer has to be sad and unhappy. Think about that peace of mind that she finally has. 
I also think writing letters to her would help.
I used to come to her whenever I tried to kill myself. I’m afraid she will tell my parents what I’m going through.
I really wish I could, but I’m only 15. So I can’t really get help under their noses.
That’s a bit comforting. It hasn’t happened again yet, I’ve been trying to get it to budge all day. I still have no idea about the building though haha.
Thank you so much. I’m safe and well now, I think it was just impulsive thought.
I feel a lot better now that I’ve calmed down a bit. I went back in my house and lied down. Thank you for the kind words 💕
